newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Bucaram leaves Ecuador to defend cause.
newsitem.headline: Bucaram leaves Ecuador to defend cause.

text.p: Ecuador's ousted president Abdala Bucaram left the country on Tuesday for Panama on a tour to tell regional countries that he was deposed in what he called a "congressional coup".
Bucaram told local TC Television at Guayaquil airport that he would "denounce that corruption has taken over in Ecuador."
From Panama, he said he would go on to Argentina on Wednesday to meet President Carlos Menem and then to Colombia, Haiti "and other Latin American countries."
He planned to return to Ecuador next Tuesday, he said.
Bucaram, a 45-year-old populist, was dismissed by Congress last Thursday on grounds of "mental incompetence" after only six months in power.
Congress was meeting Tuesday to name a successor to rule until August 1998. Bucaram emphatically repeated that "the only interim president is Vice President Rosalia Arteaga."
